inputs.research_objective: Assess whether a latency optimization satisfies a tail-latency deployment constraint.
inputs.rule: Sort ascending. p95 uses nearest rank ceil(.95*n). Accept iff candidate p95 <= 30 and candidate arithmetic mean <= baseline mean. Return JSON {baseline_mean_ms:number,candidate_mean_ms:number,candidate_p95_ms:number,accept:boolean}.

assignment.task: Assess whether a latency optimization satisfies a tail-latency deployment constraint. Apply the public fixture rule and produce only the requested JSON answer.
